claims.claim_text: Executive leader whose scope spans IBM-AWS alliance co-sell motions and platform productization, with a record of IP-led revenue and margin expansion.
From that commercial base, joint solution development and alliance GTM execution frame cloud-partner co-sell motions around modernization opportunities.
Against that lineage backdrop, release automation and security scanning were embedded in regulated modernization paths, while alliance cadence delivered 20% joint revenue growth.
In parallel, DevSecOps pipeline security and automated release controls strengthened delivery resilience across modernization work.
The same platform discipline advanced platform productization, generating $22M in IP-led revenue while expanding margins.
This combined partnership, delivery, and monetization foundation can support continued partner-led platform IP growth with technical consistency, commercial accountability, and disciplined execution.
